sites.name: Game Nerdz
sites._note: BigCommerce (Stencil) site. Product grid is JS-rendered so we read the embedded analytics data blob instead of scraping selectors; see parse_bigcommerce_bodl() in monitor.py. Alerts link to this category page rather than the exact product page.

sites.name: TCG Guy Hub
sites._note: Wix Stores site. Category page is server-rendered so the generic HTML scraper works directly against Wix's own data-hook attributes.

sites.name: Miniature Market
sites._note: Shopware site. The URL is pre-filtered to their 'Palworld' brand property so we don't have to scan their whole 'Other CCGs' catalog. Stock detection is absence-based: a .stock-notify-wrapper element only renders when the item is sold out, so the default in_stock_text ('in stock', which won't match its 'Out of stock' text) correctly reads presence-of-element as sold out and absence as in stock.

sites.name: CCGPrime
sites._note: Requested via a shop.app storefront link (shop.app/m/jxk1unb9vq) - that's a Shopify 'Shop app' listing, not the merchant's real domain. Resolved to their actual Shopify store at ccgprime.com and use the standard search-based approach against that instead, since it's the authoritative source (shop.app's own availability display was stale/out of sync with the real storefront during testing).
